description: Exploratory comparison of independent RY occurrence derivatives and their layer-tied sums; no trained models or QPU noise.
parameterization: RY angles contain fixed feature offsets plus one shared trainable additive offset per circuit layer. Independent derivatives are computed per RY occurrence; tied derivatives are the sum of the occurrence derivatives in the layer.
validation: All parameter-shift expectations compared with independent matrix-free NumPy statevector oracle; tied layer derivatives checked by central finite differences.
primary_recorded_costs: structural-zero fractions under independent and tied parameterizations
